groups.title: Input Validation & Output Encoding
groups.question: Explain how you stop untrusted input from causing harm as it moves through your code.

followUps.Input Validation Strategies: Why validate with an allowlist on the server instead of a blocklist, or only in the browser?
followUps.Parameterized Queries & ORM Safety: How can an app that uses an ORM still be open to SQL injection?

groups.title: Static Analysis (SAST)
groups.question: Explain how automated tools can find security problems in your code and dependencies before release.

followUps.SAST Tools & Integration: Name a kind of bug a static analysis tool can catch before the code ever runs.
followUps.Dependency Scanning: Why do you need to scan dependencies you didn't write, and what do you do with a finding?

groups.title: Secure Code Review
groups.question: Explain what you look for when reviewing code for security, and how errors should be handled.

followUps.Security-Focused Code Review: What does a security review look for that a normal code review often misses?
followUps.Error Handling & Information Disclosure: Why is showing a stack trace to the user dangerous, and what should happen instead?

groups.title: Deserialization & File Upload Security
groups.question: Explain the risks of accepting files and serialized objects from users, and how you handle them safely.

followUps.Insecure Deserialization: How can deserializing untrusted data lead to code running on your server?
followUps.Secure File Upload Handling: Which checks should a file upload go through, and why store uploads outside the web root?
